item.title: Processional of the Damned DLC is coming out on December 8!
item.description:
The release date for DLC4: Processional of the Damned has been announced! The final expansion for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader unlocks on December 8 on PC and console.

Meet Stella the Miraculist, a living relic of the Ecclesiarchy. Trail her visions to a mysterious region of space known as the Processional of the Damned and explore a massive voidship graveyard orbiting a dying star. Uncover its secrets, discover its riches, and meet its uncanny denizens, walking a thin line between reality and madness.

Utilize the brand new Zealot archetype, equip your crew with grenade launchers, and emerge from this cursed place with immeasurable spoils — or succumb to insanity, dooming yourself and your crew to stay here forever.

Are you bold enough to see this to the end, Lord Captain?

item.title: Patch 9.0.5
item.description:
Hey folks,

Patch 9.0.5 has just rolled out to Total War: WARHAMMER III, introducing a swathe of changes to Victory Objectives and Rewards, alongside a hefty quantity of bug fixes and balancing changes. You can read the full Patch Notes below.

With these Patch Notes, we’ve separated them out into the following order:

  • Victory Rewards

  • Victory Objectives

  • General Changes/Fixes

  • Faction-Specific Changes/Fixes

  • Battle Balance Changes (not included below, but can be found here)

Hopefully this will help you to get clued up on what’s changed for the factions you most commonly play, but if you have any feedback or suggestions on how these are presented please do let us know in the comments.

The team will be monitoring things in the wake of this release for any urgent hotifixing requirements, so as always, if you run into any new issues after updating to 9.0.5 please raise them over in our dedicated bug reporting sub-forum with as much information as possible to help our QA teams investigate.

Let’s jump into the notes…

Victory Rewards

We’ve taken a deep look at the campaign victory rewards and have made some significant changes based on your feedback to make these victories feel more impactful and rewarding.

General 

  • Unique Lords and Heroes granted through victory rewards now start at rank 20, and come fully equipped with rare items and with a unique trait.

Unique Lord and Hero Rewards 

The following unique characters receive the listed reward traits and effects:

Khazrak the One-Eyed (Beastlord)

Trait: Disciplined (Empowered) 

  • Melee attack and defence for lord. 

  • Unbreakable for Ungor, Gor and Bestigor units rank 7 and above. 

  • Unit cap for Ungor, Gor and Bestigor units

  • Unyielding assault for Ungor, Gor and Bestigor units

Taurox the Brass Bull (Doombull) 

Trait: Aggressive (Empowered) 

  • Weapon strength. 

  • Charge bonus and melee attack for lord. 

  • Unit cap for Minotaurs. 

  • Perfect vigour for Minotaurs. 

Morghur the Shadowgave (Great Bray Shaman) 

Trait: Knowledgeable (Empowered) 

  • Character experience gain for all characters. 

  • Magic item drop chance. 

  • Improves the rarity of items gained from battle. 

  • Chance to forge a unique item when fusing two rare items. 

  • Research rate. 

Malagor the Dark Omen (Great Bray Shaman) 

Trait: Intelligent (Empowered) 

  • Spell intensity. 

  • Winds of Magic cost. 

  • Cooldown to spells. 

  • Magic attacks for army. 

  • Unit capacity for monsters. 

Kroq-Gar (Saurus Scar-Veteran)

Trait: Weapon Master (Empowered) 

  • Armour-piercing damage. 

  • Melee attack. 

  • Executioner. 

  • Unyielding Assault. 

  • Contact effect "Rattled". 

Ungrim (Lord) 

Trait: Military Strategist 

  • Research rate. 

  • Construction cost for military support buildings (faction-wide). 

  • Unit experience gain per turn (army). 

  • Campaign movement range. 

  • Upkeep reduction (army). 

Louen (Lord) 

Trait: Virtue of the Joust (Empowered) 

  • Chivalry per turn. 

  • Glorious charge for Lord. 

  • Glorious charge for Knights. 

  • Charge bonus for Knights. 

  • Ward save for Knights. 

Fay Enchantress (Prophetess) 

Trait: Intelligent (Empowered) 

  • Chivalry per turn. 

  • Spell intensity. 

  • Winds of Magic cost. 

  • Cooldown to spells. 

  • Barrier hit points for army. 

Orion (Glade Lord) 

Trait: Focused Presence 

  • Corruption reduction. 

  • Range (army). 

  • Missile strength (army). 

  • Ability number of uses for the Arrow of Kurnous (characters in army). 

  • Cooldown to Arrow of Kurnous (characters in army). 

Durthu (Ancient Treeman) 

Trait: Lamentation of Despairs (Empowered) 

  • Ward save. 

  • Corruption reduction. 

  • Ability (Lamentation of Despairs Empowered). 

  • Leadership (army). 

  • Reduced leadership for enemies. 

Sisters of Twilight (Spellweaver lord) 

Trait: Cleansing Magic 

  • Spell intensity. 

  • Corruption reduction. 

  • Miscast base chance. 

  • Winds of Magic power reserve cap. 

  • Winds of Magic per turn. 

Balthasar Gelt (General of the Empire) 

Trait: Determined (Empowered) 

  • Character experience gain (army). 

  • Double experience gain for all units. 

  • Immune to Psychology (army). 

  • Hit points (lord). 

  • Unbreakable (lord). 

Volkmar the Grim (Arch Lector) 

Trait: Aggressive (Empowered) 

  • Weapon strength. 

  • Charge bonus and melee attack for lord. 

  • Increased battle loot. 

  • Magic item drop chance. 

N'Kari (Chaos Lord (replaced) -> Exalted Keeper of Secrets) 

Trait: Siren (Empowered) 

  • Summon Disciple Army size increase. 

  • Enables Enriched Soporific Musk attacks. 

  • Melee defence. 

  • Reduced melee defence for enemies in region. 

  • Reduced vigour for enemies in region. 

Daemon Prince (Exalted Lord) 

Trait: Tough (Empowered) 

  • Hit Points. 

  • Armour. 

  • Immune to Flanking. 

  • Melee defence (army). 

  • Ward save (army). 

Boris Ursus (Ataman (replaced) -> Boyar) 

Trait: Kislev Warrior 

  • Expert Charge Defence for infantry units. 

  • Devastating Flanker for cavalry units. 

  • Immune to Chaos corruption and Chaos Wastes attrition. 

  • Devotion for province. 

  • Corruption reduction for province. 

Morathi (Dreadlord (replaced) -> Sorceress hero (shadows)) 

Trait: Malefic 

  • Spell intensity. 

  • Targeting range for spells.

  • Cooldown to spells. 

  • Winds of Magic power reserve capacity.

  • Contact effect "Dampened" for all characters in the army.

Azhag (Orc Warboss) 

Trait: Serial Danca (Empowered) 

  • Unbreakable. 

  • Perfect vigour. 

  • Frenzy for infantry units. 

  • Vigour loss reduction (army). 

  • Campaign movement range. 

Wurrzag (Goblin Great Shaman) 

Trait: Lucky 

  • Spell intensity. 

  • Cooldown to all spells. 

  • Winds of magic reserve capacity. 

  • Physical resistance (army). 

  • Magic item drop chance. 

Luthor Harkon (Vampire Fleet Admiral) 

Trait: Lustrian Smuggler 

  • Loyalty will not decline. 

  • Immune to diplomatic penalties from trespassing. 

  • Income from all settlement buildings (faction-wide). 

  • Magic item drop chance. 

  • Campaign movement range. 

  • Reduced upkeep (army). 

Cylostra Direfin (Vampire Fleet Admiral) 

Trait: Murderer (Empowered) 

  • Loyalty will not decline. 

  • Weapon strength. 

  • Melee attack. 

  • Contact effect "Discouraged". 

  • Reduced enemy leadership in region. 

  • Causes Terror (army). 

Neferata (Lahmian Bloodline lord) 

Trait: Flesh and Bones

  • Unit capacity for Lahmian Handmaidens and Coven Thrones. 

  • Hero action success chance increase and cost reduction in region. 

  • Battle speed (army). 

  • Physical resistance (army). 

  • Also comes with a set of 4 random Vampire Lair traits. 

Prince Sigvald and Azazel (Exalted Keeper of Secrets) 

Fixed an issue where the Exalted Keeper of Secrets didn’t have access to the Warriors of Chaos blue line.

Trait: Perfectionist (Empowered) 

  • Slaanesh Authority. 

  • Seduce units capacity. 

  • Seduce units budget. 

  • Seduce units cost. 

  • Unit experience gain (faction-wide). 

  • Gifted Units capacity (all armies). 

Festus (Exalted Great Unclean One) 

Fixed an issue where the Exalted Great Unclean One didn’t have access to the Warriors of Chaos blue line.

Trait: Plagueist (Empowered) 

  • Nurgle Authority. 

  • Chance of a plague spreading (armies in province). 

  • Weapon strength, Melee attack and Melee defence for Plaguebearers and Exalted Plaguebearers (army). 

  • Gifted Units capacity (all armies). 

Valkia (Exalted Bloodthirster)

Fixed an issue where the Exalted Bloodthirster didn’t have access to a blue line in his skill tree. It now has access to the Warriors of Chaos blue line.

Trait: Maimer (Empowered)

  • Khorne Authority. 

  • Armour-piercing damage. 

  • Unyielding Assault. 

  • Perfect Vigour. 

  • Flammable attacks. 

  • Gifted Units capacity (all armies). 

Vilitch (Exalted Lord of Change) 

Fixed an issue where the Exalted Lord of Change didn’t have access to the Warriors of Chaos blue line.

Trait: Channeller (Empowered)

  • Tzeentch Authority. 

  • Chance of Winds of Magic increasing in strength. 

  • Winds of Magic capacity. 

  • Winds of Magic per turn. 

  • Barrier hit points (army). 

  • Gifted Units capacity (all armies). 

Miao Ying (Dragon-Blooded Shugengan Lord) 

Trait: Ferocious 

  • Armour-piercing damage. 

  • Spell intensity. 

  • Causes Terror. 

  • Frenzy (army). 

  • Vigour loss reduction (army). 

Yuan Bo (Celestial General) 

Trait: Inspiring 

  • Campaign movement range. 

  • Upkeep reduction (army). 

  • Leadership (army). 

  • Vigour loss reduction (army). 

  • Immune to psychology (army). 

Faction Reward Changes 

Beastmen 

  • Talisman of Chaos (short victory reward) - now provides combat buffs to its wearer in addition to its other effects and the dread gained from battles was increased. 

  • Long Victory: Lord recruit rank changed to lord and hero recruit rank. 

Lizardmen 

  • Long Victory: Added an effect bundle that increases all Blessed Spawnings unit capacities. 

Mazdamundi (Short Victory):

  • Increased Blessed Temple Guard cap. 

  • Added construction cost reduction for Geomantic buildings in addition to the current effects. 

Kroq-Gar (Short Victory): 

  • Added Blessed Saurus Spears (Shields) to his unit cap increase. 

Tehenhauin (Short Victory): 

  • Increased cap for Blessed Skink Cohort and Skirmishers. 

  • Added a "reduced cost for sacrifices to Sotek rituals" effect to the bundle and a reduced cooldown to the Rite of Sotek.

  • Added an "ability number of uses" effect for his Terradon battle abilities. 

  • Added a "reduced cooldown for the Rite of Tzunki" effect. 

Gor Rok (Short Victory): 

  • Added a melee attack bonus to the Saurus ancillary in addition to its other effects (also adjusted the values of the other effects slightly). 

  • Added Blessed Saurus Spears (Shields) to his unit cap increase. Also reduced cost and cooldown for Rite of Resilience. 

Nakai (Short Victory): 

  • Added a reduced cost and cooldown to the Rite of Mastery. 

  • Added tribute gain from vassals and reduced cost for Rite of Allegiance. 

Oxyotl (Short Victory): 

  • Changed his blessed spawnings capacity from skinks to Blessed Chameleon Skinks and Blessed Chameleon Stalkers and increased the cap further. 

  • Also added 2 effect that increase the capacity and recruit rank of Skink Oracles.

  • Increased the Sanctum Gems that are awarded upon achieving victory so that you can actually unlock sanctums.

  • Long Victory: Added a bundle that decreases the cooldown of all rites.

Tyrion 

  • Short Victory: Added a control and morale bonuses to the "Highborn Baladeer" follower.

  • Short Victory: Added an upkeep reduction effect to her "Handmaiden" follower.

  • Short Victory: Added armour-piercing missile damage and range for the Shadow Banner ancillary. Achieving victory will now also provide multiple of those banners.

  • Short Victory: Legacy of Moranian now increases the unit cap for all Mistwalker units. Also added upkeep reduction and some ward save for Mistwalker units. 

  • Increased duration for Warden's Cage (faction-wide), instead of reducing Warden's Supply costs. Also added an influence per turn effect.

  • Short Victory: Added an income from ports effect to the "Experienced Buccaneer" follower.

  • Long Victory: Increased the effect values of the "Forest Weaver" bundle.

Drycha

  • Short Victory: Added a Wild Spirits capacity increase effect to "The Council of Beasts" bundle.

Skaven

  • Long Victory: Added a Food capacity effect to the "Improvised Bounty" bundle and increased the food per turn a little.

  • Short Victory: Increased the upkeep reduction in the "City of Pillars" bundle.

  • Short Victory: Slight increase to the provided warp fuel.

  • Short Victory: Increased the unit experience gain and prestige effect values (Biographer ancillary).

  • Short Victory: Increased the ward save effect, provided by the "Scholar's Aegis" item.

  • Short Victory: Now provides 2x Helstorm Rocket Battery, 2x Steam tank and 2x Demigryph Knights.

  • Long Victory: No longer provides units, instead provides lord and hero recruit rank.

  • Increased the amount of provided Amethyst Ironsides.

  • The Call to Order bundle now also provides recruitment capacity for Chosen of Ulric units and some Fervour per turn.

  • Short Victory: Beast Baiters now also provides some upkeep reduction for Monsters.

  • Increased the number of Monster Pen units awarded upon achieving victory.

Greenskins

  • Long Victory: Now increases both Lord and Hero recruit rank. Also increased the pooled resource rewards

Skarsnik

  • Short Victory: New Home now also provides some faction-wide growth.

  • Short Victory: Increased the scrap cost reduction for upgrading units coming from the "Old Knives" bundle.

Gorbad Ironclaw

  • Short Victory: Increased the Research rate provided by "Da Planner".

Ogre Kingdoms

  • Short Victory: Ogre Slopper's effect values were increased.

Greasus

  • Short Victory: Bean Counter's effects are now faction-wide with adjusted values. Additionally, it reduces the cost of Tyrant's Demands actions, and reduces the cooldown of tier 3 and 4 Tyrant's Demands actions.

Skrag

  • Short Victory: Gore-Gnoblar Gang's effects are now factionwide and values were increased. Additionally, it now also slightly lowers the "Offer to the Great Maw" cost (faction-wide).

Golgfag

  • Short Victory: Bountiful Contracts' effects values were increased. Additionally, the bundle now provides unit experience gain from battles against contract targets and some post-battle loot.

Tomb Kings

  • Long Victory: Increased the Canopic Jars reward value.

  • Added a new bundle that provides army and unit capacities.

  • Short Victory: Mortuary Cult Embalmer's effect values were noticeably increased.

Khalida

  • Short Victory: Boosted the growth provided by "Lybaras the Magnificent".

Arkhan

  • Short Victory: Vizier of Khemri now properly increases the unit capacities of all vampire units that he has access to.

Vampire Coast

  • Long Victory: Added bonuses to Lord and Hero recruit rank to their long victory rewards as well.

  • Short Victory: Pirate Flag now also provides Pirate crew growth and additionally, doubles the income of Pirate Cove buildings.

Count Noctilus

  • Short Victory: Zombie Carpenter no longer provides construction time and cost for ship buildings. Instead it provides campaign movement, "Immune to Flanking" and Ward Save for Necrofex Colossus units.

Aranessa Saltspite

  • Short Victory: Lucky Chanties now provides more treasury from Treasure Maps. Additionally, it provides a faction-wide increase to Magic item drop chance and income from post-battle loot.

Vampire Counts

  • Long Victory: Deathly Gale now provides more Blood per turn. Additionally, it increases the unit capacity of all units.

Neferata

  • Short Victory: Mistress of Silence provides more Manipulation per turn and also increases Manipulation capacity.

Mannfred

  • Short Victory: Immortal Insight now reduces Vampire Lair related costs more.

  • Keeper of Forbidden Lore now also provides some Research rate increase and Character experience gain (faction-wide), in addition to its other effects.

Vlad & Isabella

  • Immortal Aristocracy also reduces the upkeep and increases the melee attack and defence of all armies led by von Carstein Vampire lords. (This also includes Vlad, Isabella and Mannfred)

Vlad

  • Short Victory: Drakenhof Loyalist's Control effect is now faction-wide. Additionally, it now also provides some growth and income from all buildings.

Isabella

  • Short Victory: Sanguine Steward now also provides battle healing cap for Vampire heroes.

Heinrich Kemmler

  • Short Victory: Wraithbringer now provides Ward Save for Cairn Wraiths and Hexwraiths, instead of Physical resistance. Additionally, the armour-piercing damage effect value was increased slightly.

  • Vengeful Spirits now also reduces construction time for the Vengeful Spirits building chain. Additionally, it provides unit capacity increase for Cairn Wraiths, Hexwraiths and Mortis Engines.

Helman Ghorst

  • Short Victory: Corpse Carter's corpse per turn effect value was increased, itsrecruitment effect is now faction-wide. Additionally, it further reduces the amount of Corpses lost when transporting them to the capital.

  • Master Necromancer's recruit rank effect now also works on Skeleton Warriors and Spearmen. Additionally, it provides some Replenishment and Dead Rise Again chance and hit points restored for all units.

Warriors of Chaos

  • Long Victory: Increased the provided Souls.

  • Short Victory: Spirit Ensnarer now also allows replenishment in foreign territory.

Archaon the Everchosen

  • Short Victory: Swords of Chaos capacity increased to +3 from +2.

Be’lakor

  • Short Victory: Path Through Shadows reduces the cooldown for "The Curser's Boon" further. Additionally, it provides campaign movement for all armies.

The Glottkin

  • Short Victory: Grotesque Gardener now also reduces cycle time for all Garden of Corruption buildings.

  • The Flail of a Thousand Coughs' armour-piercing damage was slightly increased.

Grand Cathay
Zhao Ming

  • Short Victory: Foreign Ventures also increases sale value of cargo and the maximum cargo capacity.

Bhashiva

  • Short Victory: Daughter of Prophecy now also provides unit experience per turn (faction-wide).

Undead Legions
Nagash

  • Short Victory: The Undying King now provides more sigils available to empower within the Pyramid.

  • Long Victory: All effect values of The Supreme Lord of Undeath bundle were increased.

Victory Objectives

Vampire Counts
Isabella von Carstein

  • Isabella will now have her own victory objectives, instead of reusing Vlad’s.

Dark Elves
Morathi

    • Immortal Empires - Morathi will now have access to Daemonettes of Slaanesh and Exalted Daemonettes of Slaanesh, regardless of WH3 ownership.

Rakarth

  • Rakarth’s long victory now requires you to recruit 15 unique Monster Pen units, down from 17.

Empire
Karl Franz

Skaven
Snikch

Beastmen
Morghur

  • Morghur’s victory objective related to The Oak of Ages was changed to “Capture and Occupy” from “Raze” to avoid a possible conflict with his short victory conditions.

Warriors of Chaos
The Glottkin

  • The Glottkin’s Short Victory kills condition has been removed.

  • The Glottkin’s Long Victory kills condition has been reduced from 7k to 5k.

General Changes/Fixes

Performance & Stability

  • Fixed a crash that could occur when trying to reset the skills of a confederated character.

Campaign

Campaign Customisation

  • Added the “Endgame Difficulty: Legendary” checkbox customisation option for Endgame scenarios. Available when starting new campaigns.

    • This option changes various things associated with each scenario, including the bonuses the Endgame factions gain, their spawn rate (where applicable), other AI factions capability of dealing with the Endgame, some changes to the final battles, and other smaller changes.

General/Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where Endgame factions could declare war on various critical narrative-linked factions, such as the Shanty armies for Vampire Coast, which could result in some Long Victory objectives being unachievable.

  • In the Chaos Invasion final battle, if playing on Legendary Endgame difficulty, Archaon and his initial units will maintain their campaign ward save (reinforcements will not).

  • AI factions should now perform better against the endgame scenarios, less so if playing on Legendary Endgame difficulty.

  • Fixed an issue where Glottkin's Long Victory objective to fully upgrade Grandfather's Blessings was not updating.

  • Fixed a visual bug when The Silver Road province is affected with devastation.

  • Added bespoke traits for when Boris Todbringer and Khazrak the One-Eye defeat each other in battle.

  • Fixed an issue where special traits for Short Victory reward unique characters were not being applied correctly.

  • Fixed a bug where the endgame adviser can trigger on loading screens.

Hey folks,

Patch 9.0.5 has just rolled out to Total War: WARHAMMER III, introducing a swathe of changes to Victory Objectives and Rewards, alongside a hefty quantity of bug fixes and balancing changes. You can read the full Patch Notes below.

With these Patch Notes, we’ve separated them out into the following order:

  • Victory Rewards

  • Victory Objectives

  • General Changes/Fixes

  • Faction-Specific Changes/Fixes

  • Battle Balance Changes (not included below, but can be found here)

Hopefully this will help you to get clued up on what’s changed for the factions you most commonly play, but if you have any feedback or suggestions on how these are presented please do let us know in the comments.

The team will be monitoring things in the wake of this release for any urgent hotifixing requirements, so as always, if you run into any new issues after updating to 9.0.5 please raise them over in our dedicated bug reporting sub-forum with as much information as possible to help our QA teams investigate.

Let’s jump into the notes…

Victory Rewards

We’ve taken a deep look at the campaign victory rewards and have made some significant changes based on your feedback to make these victories feel more impactful and rewarding.

General 

  • Unique Lords and Heroes granted through victory rewards now start at rank 20, and come fully equipped with rare items and with a unique trait.

Unique Lord and Hero Rewards

Trait: Disciplined (Empowered) 

  • Melee attack and defence for lord.

  • Unyielding assault for Ungor, Gor and Bestigor units

Trait: Aggressive (Empowered) 

  • Weapon strength. 

  • Charge bonus and melee attack for lord. 

  • Unit cap for Minotaurs. 

  • Perfect vigour for Minotaurs.

Trait: Knowledgeable (Empowered) 

  • Character experience gain for all characters.

  • Chance to forge a unique item when fusing two rare items. 

  • Research rate.

Trait: Intelligent (Empowered) 

  • Spell intensity. 

  • Winds of Magic cost. 

  • Cooldown to spells. 

  • Magic attacks for army. 

  • Unit capacity for monsters.

Trait: Weapon Master (Empowered)

  • Melee attack.

  • Unyielding Assault.

item.title: Community Update - October
item.description:
Hello Space Marines,

It’s time for our monthly Community Update! We’re keeping things a little lighter this time around, as the team is fully focused on cooking up new content for Patch 16 and beyond. Don’t worry, we’ll have plenty to show you soon!

Now, let’s discuss the most recent topics around Space Marine 2, as well as our latest milestone and the upcoming community events!

RECENT TOPICS

Reddit Q&A with Game Director

Recently, we hosted a Q&A on Reddit, and got many entries. Game Director Dmitry Grigorenko answered a bunch of questions from you. The entire retranscription is here! Read it now 😊

Hotfixes 15.1 / 15.2

This month, we deployed the Hotfix 15.1 and Hotfix 15.2 to address key issues and improve overall gameplay balance.

Here’s a quick summary of some of the changes brought to the game:

One-Handed Thunder Hammer & Power Maul: Buffed overall damage, sped up charge time, and improved movesets.

Melta Rifles: Improved damage range fall off and increased base ammo/magazine capacity.

Game modes: Various balance changes and bug fixes in Chaos Siege, and resolved multiple bugs in Crucible.

QoL & Fixes: Added brief invulnerability after knockback, fixed item spawns out of bounds, and resolved cloth/robe customization color bugs.

Twitch Drops

We’ve taken good note of your discontent surrounding our last Drops campaign, where the Victrix Honour Guard Storm Shield was available through Twitch’s “Support A Streamer” feature and required a purchase. We will make this shield available in the Refinement & Redemption shop with the launch of Patch 17. It’ll be unlockable with Requisition Points, as this was the case for our previous Drops.

PATCH 16

Patch 16 will bring no less than 6 new Heroic Weapons. Let’s unveil them:

  • Omnissian Axe: holding the attack generates and maintains a big shock zone.

  • Heavy Bolt Pistol: fire rate is increased when shooting without aiming, and the damage is greatly increased in close range.

  • Bolt Rifle: rhythmic firing of single shots gradually increases damage.

  • Las Fusil: doesn’t need to be charged and slowly regenerates ammo.

  • Plasma Incinerator: damage is increased when overheating.

  • Infernus Heavy Bolter: has an underbarrel flamethrower.

Also, here’s a first teaser for the upcoming Mortifactors Cosmetic Pack:

15 MILLION PLAYERS

This month we’re celebrating another amazing milestone, which makes us very proud: Space Marine 2 has reached 15 Million Players! 🎊🍾

Fifteen million is a number we didn’t even imagine reaching when we released the game two years ago. We know very well that the community plays the most part in spreading love for the game to new players. So, on behalf of Saber and Focus; we truly thank every single one of you. And to the newest Space Marines among you, welcome! Glory to you and the Emperor! 💙

YEAR 3 PASS - SCREENSHOT CONTEST

To celebrate Halloween, and the best season of the year returning, we’re hosting a contest! This time, let us see the spookiest screenshots/virtual photos you have taken in Space Marine 2. 🎃🦇

  • Two winners will be picked on November 2nd. Both of them will receive a Year 3 Pass key for Steam. 

  • Submit your entry either on Discord or on X!

📅 You have until November 1st to participate. Good luck 👻

COMMUNITY EVENT 

A Community Event is still live right now until November 03!

Hold the line and survive a total of 15 waves in Chaos Siege Mode to earn 100 Accolades. These 15 waves may be completed through several sessions combined, and each completed one will count regardless of your difficulty setting. Join the battle now!

FOCUS TOGETHER COMMUNITY IDEAS

This month, we took a deep dive into your ideas on Focus Together to get your feedback on various features and gameplay elements. Here are some of the most popular community ideas, along with responses directly from our Game Director, Dmitry Grigorenko:

1. Account-wide progression in Crucible Mode

💡{LINK REMOVED}Community ​idea: Make Crucible progression account-wide rather than character-bound to reduce the grind and allow more freedom to switch classes. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: It’s been only a few days since the latest hotfix that fixed various manipulations with difficulty of the mode and we want to give players a bit more time and gather more data before making any harsh decisions, like suggested. We do want to keep the progression per class, but the speed of the progression and balance of specific penances will be adjusted if necessary once we have more data. We just need more time to analyse it.

2. Mandatory team perks

💡{LINK REMOVED}Community ​idea: Restrict access to Absolute difficulty so that players must have a Team Perk equipped. This prevents under-leveled or under-prepared players from joining top-tier missions and improves mission success rates.

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: We are planning to implement a level lock to end game activities like Hard Stratagems and Hard Siege. Team perk restriction seems very specific and currently not planned.

3. Blood Angels Champion customization

💡Community Idea: Update and expand customization options for the Blood Angels Champion cosmetic parts to better match Chapter lore and armor sets.

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: I don’t want to spoil things and say yes or no to this. Lets just say there will be some major improvements in this area further down the line.

4. Omni-Scrambler for the Tactical

💡Community Idea: Add the Omni-Scrambler wargear to the Tactical class to offer more customization options. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: Omni-Scrambler is a very specific device in the lore that is not available for Intercessors. However, actual Deathwatch backpacks and devices are currently in plans for Tactical.

5. MK VI Greave Emblems

 

💡Community Idea: Allow emblems/decals to be placed on the upper area of the Mk VI "Corvus" greaves so players can apply appropriate Chapter, squad, and campaign markings. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: Yes this is currently planned.

6. Backpack Emblem customization

💡Community Idea: Allow players to apply emblems and decals to power backpacks, similar to the existing options for knee markings.

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: This is something that has been sitting in our backlog for a while. We will come back to it once we finish with already planned customization improvements, since those will be more impactful.

7. Starting equipment selection

💡Community Idea: Allow players to select their starting equipment/grenades in loadouts to better support specific class builds and playstyles. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: We would like to keep the exploration and randomness aspect of PvE. With the abundance of equipment restoration perks this would mean that everyone would just pick a melta bomb.

8. Sniper hood customization 

💡Community Idea: Add more hooded head options for the Sniper class and allow hoods to be recolored to better fit different Chapter color schemes. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: Yes this is currently in the works right now.

That’s it for this month!

As always, we want to thank you for the unwavering support, and we remain attentive to your feedback with every update. 

Don’t forget you can follow Focus on all our socials (Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X and Bluesky) and join the community on Discord now!

See you next month, Space Marines.

The Emperor Protects 🪽

The Saber & Focus teams

item.title: Special Live Event: Arcane Ruin + Hotfix 1.13.4
item.description:
Admonition scholars have uncovered an ancient ritual buried deep within their foul, heretic tomes. Using these fell rites, they have bound a powerful daemon into a Daemonhost. Agents report that this new horror seems to appear when others of its kin are slain.

Emboldened by the dreaded Daemonhost Gormaggoth’s presence, the streets are plagued with lesser Daemonhosts. Seek them out and destroy them.

Starting today until November 5, participate in the event by playing missions with the ‘Hunted’ condition, and destroy the Daemonhosts.

Beware, the Daemonhost Gormaggoth has an ever-increasing chance of appearing for every one of its kin you slay. Uncover more about the origin of these heretical abominations as you battle this terrible foe.

This event has two forms of progression! 

  • Killing Daemonhosts in missions with the ‘Hunted’ condition will progress your personal event tracker, which rewards you with Dockets, Diamantine, Plasteel, and this brand new Weapon Charm:

  • Dealing damage to the dreaded Daemonhost Gormaggoth will advance a community event tracker, which every player contributes to! This rewards the entire playerbase with Dockets, Diamantine and Plasteel, as well as unlocking new lore short stories (written by Dan Abnett!) with each step.

    • If the community racks up enough damage, the Daemonhost Gormaggoth will be slain for good, unlocking this brand new Portrait frame:

Hotfix 1.13.4 is now being rolled out on all platforms, and while you wait for it to download you can read the notes below!

This hotfix contains a handful of important fixes, including reducing the Vanguards’ health and fixing some crashes.

Patch 1.13.4 patch notes
General Fixes

  • Scab Vanguard & Dreg Vanguard: reduced their health back to their correct, intended values.

  • Fixed crash affecting players on AMD RX 7000 series GPUs. As a workaround, FSR 4.1.1 has been disabled for RDNA3 GPUs on Windows 10.

  • Fixed startup crash on Intel Arc GPUs linked to the XeSS module.

  • Fixed a crash that could occur when tracking any of the removed "The Depths Purge the Unclean" Penances

  • Fixed the launcher so that it doesn't create a crash dump file on shutdown.

  • Fixed an issue where the launcher could block players from starting the game.

Cosmetic Fixes

  • Fixed some clipping with Drill Fatigues (Cadian 43rd, Broken Swords, XXXXL)

Known Issues

  • Scab and Dreg Vanguard enemies currently have slightly more health than intended.

    • Fixed!

We’ve also got some comments on a few of the changes we’ve done in the last few updates:

  • Corruption Damage Change

    • In the previous Hotfix (1.13.3) we changed how Corruption Damage is dealt. Previously, corruption damage alone couldn't outright kill you. This was only ever intended for Grimoire damage, and so we 'fixed' it for other damage sources. However, we understand that this is being relied upon by many as a feature, and so we'll keep an extra close eye on this.

  • Servo-Skull Damage Nerf

    • In the Depths of the Damned Update (1.13.0) the Servo-Skull had its Strength reduced from 160 to 100. This was an internal change that was meant to go live with the release of Skitarii in 1.12.0, meaning this was the original intended power level of the Servo-Skull, which instead went live on 1.13.0.

    • This brings us to today. Although the Servo-Skull now has the initially intended Strength, we are re-evaluating if the nerf was justified and are considering further balance adjustments to both it and the Noospheric Command Talent.

That’s all for today!

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar. 

– The Darktide Team

Beware, the Daemonhost Gormaggoth has an ever-increasing chance of appearing for every one of its kin you slay. Uncover more about the origin of these heretical abominations as you battle this terrible foe.

  • Dealing damage to the dreaded Daemonhost Gormaggoth will advance a community event tracker, which every player contributes to! This rewards the entire playerbase with Dockets, Diamantine and Plasteel, as well as unlocking new lore short stories (written by Dan Abnett!) with each step.

Hotfix 1.13.4 is now being rolled out on all platforms, and while you wait for it to download you can read the notes below!

This hotfix contains a handful of important fixes, including reducing the Vanguards’ health and fixing some crashes.

Patch 1.13.4 patch notes
General Fixes

  • Scab Vanguard & Dreg Vanguard: reduced their health back to their correct, intended values.

  • Fixed crash affecting players on AMD RX 7000 series GPUs. As a workaround, FSR 4.1.1 has been disabled for RDNA3 GPUs on Windows 10.

  • Fixed startup crash on Intel Arc GPUs linked to the XeSS module.

  • Fixed a crash that could occur when tracking any of the removed "The Depths Purge the Unclean" Penances

  • Fixed the launcher so that it doesn't create a crash dump file on shutdown.

  • Fixed an issue where the launcher could block players from starting the game.

Cosmetic Fixes

  • Fixed some clipping with Drill Fatigues (Cadian 43rd, Broken Swords, XXXXL)

Known Issues

  • Scab and Dreg Vanguard enemies currently have slightly more health than intended.

    • Fixed!

We’ve also got some comments on a few of the changes we’ve done in the last few updates:

  • Corruption Damage Change

    • In the previous Hotfix (1.13.3) we changed how Corruption Damage is dealt. Previously, corruption damage alone couldn't outright kill you. This was only ever intended for Grimoire damage, and so we 'fixed' it for other damage sources. However, we understand that this is being relied upon by many as a feature, and so we'll keep an extra close eye on this.

  • Servo-Skull Damage Nerf

    • In the Depths of the Damned Update (1.13.0) the Servo-Skull had its Strength reduced from 160 to 100. This was an internal change that was meant to go live with the release of Skitarii in 1.12.0, meaning this was the original intended power level of the Servo-Skull, which instead went live on 1.13.0.

    • This brings us to today. Although the Servo-Skull now has the initially intended Strength, we are re-evaluating if the nerf was justified and are considering further balance adjustments to both it and the Noospheric Command Talent.

That’s all for today!

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar.
